steps.title: Today's readings
steps.response: Read today's readings from your Bible, slowly and attentively.

lectio_read.text: Lectio (read). Read the day's readings aloud, slowly, more than once. Notice which word or phrase stays with you.

lectio_meditate.text: Meditatio (meditate). Hold that word before your heart, pondering what God is saying to you through it today.

lectio_pray.text: Oratio (pray). Answer the Word with your own words — praise, thanksgiving, sorrow, petition.

lectio_contemplate.text: Contemplatio (contemplate). Rest in God's presence beyond words, letting the reading settle into your life and your day.

lectio_closing_prayer.text: O Lord Jesus Christ, Word of the living God: open my heart to your Word, that I may read it with faith, ponder it with love, carry it into my day, and rest in you. Amen.

readings.feed: app-side (dynamic; never embedded in this pack)
readings.note: The verse step is the skeleton placeholder: on playback the app resolves the day's readings. The real seam is the bible riverpod layer (sancta_via_bible_data_riverpod): bibleServiceNotifierProvider loads the bundled public-domain CPDV/DRC translations (bible_data), selectedBibleTranslationProvider picks the user's translation, and scriptureByReferenceProvider / multipleScripturesProvider fetch the texts by reference. A readingsFor(date) provider (one day's lectionary readings by date) is the intended app-side integration point wrapping those providers — the pack stores only this skeleton and never embeds dynamic readings.
